----------------------------------------------
Starting Sociology Optional from scratch? Confused about how to study, revise and practise answer writing?

In this session, Pranay Agarwal Sir, Sociology Optional Faculty at Sarrthi IAS, shares a complete preparation strategy for UPSC CSE aspirants.

Learn how to:
Build conceptual clarity and understand key sociological thinkers.
Complete the syllabus with limited, reliable resources.
Integrate current affairs and PYQs into your preparation.
Prepare comprehensive notes for effective revision.
Plan multiple revisions of the entire syllabus.
Improve answer-writing speed and follow the UPSC pattern.
Practise sectional tests and full-length tests.

The session also explains a phase-wise preparation timeline for UPSC CSE 2028, covering foundation building, revision and focused answer writing.

Remember: Knowing the subject is important, but being able to present it effectively in the examination hall makes the difference.

Prepare smarter with Sarrthi IAS.
----------------------------------------------
Sarrthi IAS is a one-stop solution for UPSC CSE Preparation focusing on three main pillars, i.e Credible Faculty, Quality Content, and Affordable Courses.
